items.notes: Generated verify.yml split into 2 plays (~15 tasks each): Play 1 checks directory/file existence with stat+assert loops (bracket notation, loop_var prefixed); Play 2 checks file contents with slurp+assert and runtime service/port checks tagged molecule-notest. All fail_msg strings are static (no variable interpolation). All loops use loop_control with prefixed loop_var.

items.notes: Generated container-safe converge.yml: creates /tmp/molecule_test/ directory tree mirroring Windows paths, writes UAC/PS-policy registry markers, SQL install INI, firewall rule marker, and SQL service markers. API registration directory is explicitly kept absent. No become, no include_role, no Windows-only modules.
